opus.problem: The cited verse (Genesis 8:4) says only that the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat in the seventh month. The wind and the waters going down come from Genesis 8:1-3, so the clue is not fully supported by its own reference.

Every clue names Noah or the flood, so each one alone gives the word away. Clues 1, 2 and 7 say outright that Noah built it, which makes the answer obvious on day one. These are not medium hard. The clues should place the story with less direct details instead of naming Noah or saying he built it.
